meta.name: competitive-ads-extractor
meta.description: Extracts and analyzes competitors' ads from ad libraries (Facebook, LinkedIn, etc.) to understand what messaging, problems, and creative approaches are working. Helps inspire and improve your own ad campaigns.

copy.tagline: 提取并分析竞品广告,优化你的广告策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想了解竞品广告策略并提升自己的广告效果。
copy.tagline_en: Extract and analyze competitor ads to improve your ad campaigns.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand competitor ad strategies and boost your own ad performance.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能从 Facebook、LinkedIn 等广告库提取竞争对手的广告，分析其文案、创意和受众定位，并生成包含截图和洞察的报告。
howto.when: 当你要求分析竞争对手的广告策略、寻找广告灵感或了解市场定位时触发。

say.text: 提取 Notion 在 Facebook 广告库中的广告，分析其文案策略。
say.note: Claude 会抓取广告并生成分析报告。

say.text: 比较三家竞品的 LinkedIn 广告，找出共同模式。
say.note: Claude 会提取并对比广告模式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can extract competitors' ads from ad libraries like Facebook and LinkedIn, analyze their copy, creative, and audience targeting, and generate a report with screenshots and insights.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze competitor ad strategies, find ad inspiration, or understand market positioning.

say_en.text: Extract Notion's ads from Facebook Ad Library and analyze their copy strategy.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch ads and generate an analysis report.

say_en.text: Compare LinkedIn ads from three competitors and find common patterns.
say_en.note: Claude will extract and compare ad patterns.
